queue_pressure_map.queue_confidence_rule: medium only when role-known and normalized-position horse coverage are both >= 0.8; otherwise low; launch speed remains unobserved

ra_lap_join_coverage.note: race-level RA join。個体別sectionalではない

role_classification_coverage.note: history route populationの位置role coverage。個体roleは角位置proxy

same_condition_evidence.exact_caveat: UNJUDGED_RENOVATION_VERSION_MISSING; zero is certified-set size, not proof of no matches
same_condition_evidence.population_definition: 2024-01-01 <= date < 2026-08-23; canonical JRA flat (race type 18/19 excluded); same venue+surface+distance+inner/outer/track code and direct course setting when turf; all classes

track_condition.missing_reason: 開催当日のJRA馬場状態をfreeze前に人が記録

wind.missing_reason: 当日風向・風速を接続していない

comparison.lose_path_short: 序盤の役割が崩れ、コーナーまたは終盤で観測済みの位置維持proxyが再現しない
comparison.win_path_short: midpack帯で過大な位置確保コストを払わず、交通柔軟性・コーナー位置維持・corner_acceleration・reacceleration・高速終盤適合を満たす
